paragraphs: He is mentioned in Menachot 25a, raising an objection to Rav Ashi.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Davidson Menachot25a scalar has Rav Sima son of Rav Idi objecting to Rav Ashi, and an alternative wording makes Sima the son of Rav Ashi. Hyman's supplied Idi heading is retained; the objection direction is unchanged.
